title: CHAP. VIII. Of Christ the Mediator.

segments.text: IT pleased God in his eternal purpose, to chuse and ordain the Lord Jesus his onely begotten Son, according to a Covenant made between them both, to be the Mediator between God and Man; the Prophet, Priest, and King, the Head and Savior of his Church, the Heir of all things, and Judge of the World; unto whom he did from all eternity give a people to be his feed, and to be by him in time redeemed, called, justified, sanctified, and glorified.
